reason: I already reorder my own brand when it runs out and I have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I don't need another one. A single form of magnesium also seems like less than the 8-form capsules I already look at.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? And it is made in China, and I don't know this brand.
would_change_my_mind: A clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats a multi-form blend, plus real reviews from people I trust that it helped them sleep, at a price at or below what I pay now.
